انصهروا (form VII)
# اِنْصَهَرُوا (inṣaharū) /in.sˤa.ha.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْصَهَرَ (inṣahara)
# اِنْصَهِرُوا (inṣahirū) /in.sˤa.hi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْصَهَرَ (inṣahara)
